doc: Strict novel-allele stratum (9-allele methods-development extension). Headline strict generalization stratum from the manuscript Methods §'Cluster-aware splitting and strict novel-allele stratum'. Per-allele median AUROC of the deployed 3-seed ensemble on this stratum is 0.706 [0.648, 0.774].
exclusions_reason: Per-paper IEDB drill-down flagged these two as label-inversion outliers (per-allele AUROC < 0.40 from a single source). See manuscript Methods §'Cluster-aware splitting and strict novel-allele stratum'.
